\begin{example} \end{example}[The Hopf--Cole transformation for a quadratic-nonlinearity parabolic PDE] ↗ ex:fourier-transform-heat-fundamental-solution 1. ch4:4.4.1-ex-1\group Nonlinear to Linear PDE

For \[ u_t-a\Delta u+b|Du|^2=0,\qquad u(x,0)=g(x),\quad a>0, \] set $w=\phi (u)$ and choose $a\phi ''+b\phi '=0$, namely $w=e^{-bu/a}$. Then $w_t-a\Delta w=0$ with $w(x,0)=e^{-bg(x)/a}$, so \[ u(x,t)=-\frac ab\log \left[(4\pi at)^{-n/2} \int _{\R ^n}e^{-|x-y|^2/(4at)-bg(y)/a}\, dy\right]. \] \end{example}
